title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
why: Predictive world models select web and desktop GUI actions; interaction feedback adapts policies and models while compatibility checks retain improvements.

title: skillproof
why: Records browser actions and screen transitions to induce reusable executable skills and completion verifiers; tests execution after interface revisions.

title: Lom: desktop commander and Android GUI agents
why: Coordinates desktop and Android agents using live screens and UI structure, delegates tap/swipe/type actions, and reads execution results back.

title: ECHOES: Seeing Beyond the Current Image via Recursive History Compression and Privileged On-Policy Distillation
why: Long-horizon GUI agents compress screenshot history into recursive text state; privileged multi-image teacher distils into the policy via OPD-RL; adds failure-derived benchmark.

title: Not All Graphs Are Maps: A Task-Agnostic Exploration Framework for Mobile GUI Navigation
why: Mobile GUI agents get exploration-built destination memory with waypoint routes; changes navigation/memory; introduces navigation-only DestBench protocol.

title: MobileInject: Evaluating Reasoning-to-Action Security of MLLM-Based Mobile Agents under Cross-Modal Consistency Injection
why: Interactive benchmark of cross-modal indirect prompt injection against smartphone GUI agents; targets safety of reasoning-to-action step.

title: Beyond Next-Screen Prediction: The Decision Value of GUI World Models
why: Mobile GUI action selection: tests whether world-model lookahead helps beyond a learned direct action ranker; evaluated on AndroidWorld.

title: SPIDES: Information-Flow Control for Browser Agents
why: Browser agents' click/type/navigate actions gated by element-level information-flow labels against injection and exfiltration; new 28-site MicroNet testbed.

title: MobileJailBench: Red Queen Jailbreak Benchmarking for Mobile Agents
why: Evolving jailbreak benchmark for mobile GUI agents in a sandbox spanning 20+ apps; evaluates safety of executed workflows.

title: From Observations to Authorized Actions: Measuring Source Information in Android Agents
why: Android GUI agents reading app/WebView content: measures missing provenance in accessibility observations, prototypes source-reference gate for authorized actions.

title: Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay
why: Memory that compares repeated attempts to consolidate reusable decisions; evaluated on web agents (WebArena, Mind2Web) plus SWE-bench.

title: STRATA: Self-Maintaining Structured Experience Graphs for Self-Evolving Language Agents
why: Three-layer experience-graph memory for self-evolving agents; WebArena among four interactive benchmarks; changes memory retrieval and maintenance.

title: Visible but Not Avoided: State-Dependent Re-Proposal of Rejected Candidates in Catalog-Based LLM Optimization Loops
why: LLM optimizers improving a GUI agent's harness from a 40-edit catalog; studies re-proposal of rejected edits in the harness-search loop.

title: What It Is, Not What It Says: Securing Agentic Browsing Interactions with Web Semantics
why: Browser agents receive pages via a provenance-preserving element tree, one element at a time; changes perception interface to resist prompt injection.

title: Scout: open-source browser agent (Outcrawl)
why: Open-source agent drives a real browser, reading pages and clicking, typing, scrolling to finish tasks; full web-agent system, no paper.
